exposure: Resective-conservative surgery for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders
resective-conservative surgery for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders
cohort: 202 pregnant women with a prior pregnancy complicated by PAS disorders treated with resective-conservative surgery
finding: Subsequent pregnancies after use of resective-reconstructive surgery for PAS have demonstrated similar maternal and neonatal outcomes to typical gestation and cesarean delivery.
